data.one_liner: A Dart package to decode JSON Web Tokens, check expiry dates, and verify expiration status.
data.what_it_does: It decodes JSON Web Tokens (JWT) into a Map of their payload data, retrieves the token's expiry date, and checks if the token has expired. It is implemented as a pure Dart package with no external dependencies.
use_when: You need to decode JWT payloads on the client side in a Dart or Flutter application.
You need to quickly check if a JWT is expired without implementing custom base64 and JSON parsing logic.
avoid_when: You need to cryptographically verify or sign JWT tokens (this package only decodes and checks claims).
You are looking for a comprehensive authentication and session management provider.
strengths: Simple top-level functions for parsing, getting expiry dates, and checking expiration.
Supports all platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Does not perform cryptographic signature verification of the tokens.
Limited feature set beyond simple decoding and expiration checks.
